import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

def invoke_model(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances):
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    endpoint = aiplatform.Endpoint(endpoint_id)
    predictions = endpoint.predict(instances=instances)
    return predictions

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    location = 'us-central1'
    endpoint_id = os.getenv('ENDPOINT_ID')
    instances = [{"content": "Hello, world!"}]
    predictions = invoke_model(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances)
    print(predictions)

def stream_generation(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances):

import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

def check_safety(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances):
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    endpoint = aiplatform.Endpoint(endpoint_id)
    predictions = endpoint.predict(instances=instances)
    safe = all(prediction.safety_ratings[0].score >= 0.5 for prediction in predictions)
    return safe

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    location = 'us-central1'
    endpoint_id = os.getenv('ENDPOINT_ID')
    instances = [{"content": "Hello, world!"}]
    safe = check_safety(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances)
    print(safe)

import os
from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_output(project_id, target_language, text):
    translate_client = translate.Client(project=project_id)
    result = translate_client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    target_language = 'es'
    text = 'Hello, world!'
    translated_text = translate_output(project_id, target_language, text)
    print(translated_text)

import os
from google.cloud import language_v1 as language

def embed_output(project_id, text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient(project=project_id)
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    analysis = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document)
    sentiment = analysis.document_sentiment
    return sentiment.score

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    text = 'Hello, world!'
    sentiment_score = embed_output(project_id, text)
    print(sentiment_score)

import os
from google.cloud import texttospeech

def generate_audio(project_id, text):
    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient(project=project_id)
    input_text = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text=text)
    voice = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(language_code='en-US', ssml_gender=texttospeech.SsmlVoiceGender.NEUTRAL)
    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3)
    response = client.synthesize_speech(input=input_text, voice=voice, audio_config=audio_config)
    with open('output.mp3', 'wb') as out:
        out.write(response.audio_content)
    print('Audio content written to file "output.mp3"')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    text = 'Hello, world!'
    generate_audio(project_id, text)
